title: 2 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on 2 Kings 3: Jehoram's campaign against Moab, Elisha's word about the trenches and the water that looked like blood.

questions.text: What did Jehoram the son of Ahab put away?
questions.explanation: Jehoram did evil, but not like his father and mother, for he put away the pillar of Baal that his father had made.

answers.text: The golden calves of Bethel and Dan
The sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat
The pillar of Baal that his father had made

questions.text: What was Mesha king of Moab?
questions.explanation: Mesha king of Moab was a sheep breeder who supplied the king of Israel with the wool of lambs and rams.

questions.text: Which way did the kings choose to go up against Moab?
questions.explanation: When asked which way they should go up, the answer was, 'The way of the wilderness of Edom.'

answers.text: The way along the Jordan valley
The road through the hill country
The way of the wilderness of Edom
The way by the coast of the sea

questions.text: What did the army lack after marching for seven days along a circuitous route?
questions.explanation: After seven days of marching there was no water for the army or for the animals that followed them.

questions.text: How did one of the servants describe Elisha the son of Shaphat?
questions.explanation: A servant said that Elisha the son of Shaphat, who poured water on the hands of Elijah, was there.

answers.text: He was a priest of the house of Yahweh
He was a captain over fifty men
He was a scribe of the king of Judah
He poured water on the hands of Elijah

questions.text: What did Elisha ask to have brought to him before he prophesied?
questions.explanation: Elisha said, 'But now bring me a musician,' and when the musician played, Yahweh's hand came on him.

questions.text: What did Yahweh tell the kings to make in the valley?
questions.explanation: Elisha said, 'Yahweh says, Make this valley full of trenches.'

questions.text: At what time did the water come and fill the country?
questions.explanation: In the morning, about the time of offering the sacrifice, water came by the way of Edom and the country was filled with water.

answers.text: At midnight, while the army was asleep
At noon, in the heat of the day
In the morning, about the time of offering the sacrifice
At evening, as the sun was going down

questions.text: How did the water look to the Moabites when the sun shone on it?
questions.explanation: The sun shone on the water, and the Moabites saw it as red as blood and thought the kings had struck each other.

questions.text: What did the king of Moab do with his oldest son?
questions.explanation: The king of Moab took his oldest son, who would have reigned in his place, and offered him for a burnt offering on the wall.

answers.text: He sent him to make peace with Israel
He offered him for a burnt offering on the wall
He hid him in the city of Kir Hareseth
He gave him as a hostage to the king of Edom
